jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT POLYMARKET

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Polymarket is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own product outcomes across one or more areas of our platform. This is a high-ownership role for someone who combines strong product instincts with the operational rigor to actually get things done in a fast-moving environment. We're open to candidates who come from a traditional product background as well as those who have built their edge through operational excellence — what matters most is that you know how to drive clarity, align teams, and ship things that make a real difference.

You'll work closely with engineering, design, data, and leadership to define what we build and why, translate strategy into execution, and make sure the details don't fall through the cracks. At Polymarket, PMs are expected to be in the weeds: close to the data, close to the users, and close to the team.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own your product area. Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your domain and take accountability for the outcomes, not just the outputs.

 - Drive execution. Turn strategy into clearly scoped, well-prioritized work. Keep projects moving, remove blockers, and make sure the team always knows what they're working toward and why.

 - Get close to the data. Use quantitative and qualitative signals to understand how users are behaving, where the product is falling short, and what the highest-leverage opportunities are.

 - Work closely with engineering and design. Partner with engineers and designers from early discovery through launch, bringing the right context and making fast, well-reasoned decisions along the way.

 - Communicate clearly across the company. Keep stakeholders aligned, surface tradeoffs early, and make sure the right people have the right information at the right time.

 - Raise the bar on product quality. Push for experiences that are simple, fast, and genuinely useful and hold a high standard for what ships under your name.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in product management or a highly operational role with significant product ownership

 - A track record of shipping products or initiatives that had measurable impact, with clear evidence of your personal contribution

 - Strong analytical skills: you're comfortable in data, know how to define success metrics, and can tell the difference between a signal and noise

 - Excellent written and verbal communication: you can write a crisp PRD, run a tight meeting, and explain complex tradeoffs to any audience

 - A bias for action: you move fast, make decisions with incomplete information, and iterate based on what you learn

 - High operational rigor: you follow through, sweat the details, and make sure things actually ship the way they were intended

 - Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment where the roadmap evolves and priorities shift

 - (Plus) Familiarity with prediction markets, DeFi, or blockchain-based products

 - (Plus) Background at a high-growth startup where you've had to operate lean and move fast



BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary & equity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

 - 401k match

 - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories




PAY TRANSPARENCY 

Base salary range: $250,000 to $450,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist / Analyst, Product
jobs.description:
ABOUT POLYMARKET

Polymarket is the world's fastest growing prediction market. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing quickly, both in terms of volume ($115B traded to date) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Polymarket is looking for a Senior Data Scientist / Analyst to be the analytical partner to our product team and the person who can say whether what we shipped actually worked. You'll own product insights end-to-end, from defining its success metrics, to designing the experiments that test them, to telling the team what the results mean.

This is a role for someone with real product instincts, not just query skills. You'll spend as much time forming hypotheses about why users behave the way they do as you will validating them, and you'll be expected to push back when a feature's numbers don't support the story being told about it. You'll do it all in a fast-moving environment where we ship constantly and the answer is usually needed before the next release.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers as the analytical owner for product

 - Define the metrics that determine whether a feature worked, and be the person willing to say plainly when it did not

 - Design, instrument, and read A/B tests end-to-end, including the calls on sample size, guardrail metrics, and when to stop a test

 - Build the funnel and behavioral analyses that explain how users find a market, place a first trade, and come back for the next one

 - Turn user behavior into product direction. Surface where people drop off, what the friction actually is, and what is worth building next

 - Own the event tracking spec for your area, working with engineers so instrumentation lands correctly the first time rather than being reconstructed later

 - Work with analytics engineers to promote your recurring analyses into modeled datasets rather than one-off queries

 - Write end-to-end documentation that’s clear and thorough enough that anyone on the team can pick up your analysis without friction




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years in product analytics, data science, or a similar role supporting a consumer or trading product

 - Expert SQL. You can go from raw event tables to a defensible answer without help

 - Deep experimentation experience. You have designed and read A/B tests in production, and you can explain a null result without spinning it

 - Strong product sense. You can look at a funnel and form a hypothesis about the user behind it, not just describe the number

 - Hands-on experience defining event tracking and instrumentation, and the patience to get it right

 - Comfort with ambiguity. You can scope a vague question into a real analysis and defend the assumptions you made along the way

 - Strong communication. You can take a complex analysis to a non-technical audience and land the recommendation

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where business logic changes frequently and you need to keep pace

 - (Plus) Data science background - causal inference, quasi-experimental methods, or predictive modeling in Python or R

 - (Plus) Experience with trading, marketplace, or other two-sided products where user behavior drives the economics




BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary & equity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

 - 401k match

 - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories
   
   


PAY TRANSPARENCY 

Base salary range: $200,000 to $300,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Crypto
jobs.description:
ABOUT POLYMARKET

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Polymarket is making a high-stakes bet on crypto markets right now, and this role owns the full product surface for crypto within the US app — 15-minute markets, hourly markets, weekly markets, strike markets, up/down markets across assets. You'll be setting the roadmap, coordinating execution, and making the calls that determine whether we win or lose market share against our competitors.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. The mandate is clear: grow Polymarket's share of crypto markets, starting with the US app. Crypto markets are technically complex — with real market structure considerations, liquidity dynamics, and resolution mechanisms that matter — but the audience we're building for is retail. That tension, between crypto depth and consumer simplicity, is exactly what this role has to resolve.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Define and own the product roadmap for crypto markets in the US app, including prioritization across market formats, resolution mechanisms, and trader-facing features

 - Coordinate with engineering and design to ship and iterate on 15-minute, hourly, and weekly crypto markets, keeping execution tight and timelines honest

 - Work directly with market makers to understand liquidity constraints and improve the structure of strike and up/down markets

 - Analyze trader behavior, volume data, and liquidity metrics to identify where the product is falling short and what to build next

 - Run structured experiments on market formats, resolution mechanisms (including VWAP and TWAP), and retail onboarding flows to find what drives engagement and retention

 - Track competitive positioning against Kalshi and other platforms, and translate that into concrete product decisions

 - Represent the crypto product surface in cross-functional planning, making sure engineering, design, and business stakeholders are aligned on what matters and why
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of product management experience at a consumer-facing company, with a track record of shipping high-impact features as a senior IC

 - Deep working knowledge of crypto markets, including major assets, market dynamics, and how retail traders think about and interact with crypto products

 - Hands-on experience with trading product concepts including order books, market structure, and price resolution mechanisms such as VWAP or TWAP

 - Demonstrated ability to move fast in an ambiguous environment, make prioritization calls under pressure, and own outcomes end to end

 - Strong analytical instincts — comfortable pulling and interpreting data to inform product decisions, not just relying on intuition

 - Clear, direct communication style that works across engineering, design, and external partners like market makers

 - (Plus) Direct experience working with market makers or liquidity providers on product or market structure decisions

 - (Plus) Prior exposure to prediction markets, information markets, or event-based trading products




BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary & equity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

 - 401k match

 - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories




PAY TRANSPARENCY

Base salary range: $250,000 to $400,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager CX Tooling
jobs.description:
## About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.



## About the Role

The CX team at Polymarket is small, fast, and responsible for the experience of a global user base that trades on real-world events around the clock. Right now, the team runs on a mix of tooling that works, but not as well as it needs to. That changes with this hire.

You will own the CX tech stack end to end: the ticketing platform, CRM, AI automation including Decagon, and the integrations that tie them to Polymarket's product. This is not a coordination role. You will set the roadmap, write the specs, run the rollouts, and hold the vendor relationships. When Operations has a problem, you turn it into something Engineering can build. When a tool goes live, you own whether it lands.

This role matters because every agent on the CX team, human or AI, is only as effective as the systems underneath them. The person who takes this role will have real influence over how Polymarket scales support as the platform grows. That means making hard prioritization calls, shipping things that work now while building toward what works long-term, and staying close enough to the product to anticipate what CX will need before it becomes urgent.



## What You'll Do

- Own and prioritize the CX tech roadmap across ticketing, CRM, AI automation, and integrations, making the call on what gets built and when.

- Configure, evaluate, and continuously improve Decagon AI agents to increase automated resolution rates and reduce manual handling.

- Translate operational pain points from CX teams into clear, buildable requirements for Engineering, and follow those specs through to delivery.

- Lead tooling rollouts from kickoff through launch, coordinating across Engineering, Operations, and vendors to keep projects on track.

- Partner with product Engineering on the integrations CX depends on, including API connections, webhooks, and data flows between systems.

- Administer CX platforms day to day, owning access controls, configuration changes, and change management across the stack.

- Manage vendor relationships and contracts for CX software, including renewals, escalations, and evaluations of new tools.



## What We're Looking For

- 4 or more years in CX systems, technical program management, or a directly comparable role.

- Hands-on admin experience with at least one major support platform such as Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, or Intercom, including configuration, not just usage.

- Proven experience deploying AI agents or automation in a support context, including owning the evaluation of whether they are actually working.

- Comfortable working with APIs, webhooks, and integrations at a level where you can design a solution and review an implementation.

- Strong program management skills across multiple concurrent projects, with a track record of shipping on time without losing stakeholders along the way.

- Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences.

- (Plus) Experience building LLM evaluation frameworks or QA workflows for AI-generated responses.

- (Plus) Background working in fintech, crypto, or trading platforms where compliance, speed, and user trust are all in play.



## Benefits

- Competitive salary & equity

- Unlimited PTO

- Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

- 401k match

- Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories




PAY TRANSPARENCY 

Base salary range: $200,000 to $250,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.
